title: Implement ArxivSource in alcanzai-ingestion
description:
Salvage reference (READ ONLY — reimplement to contract, never copy): prototype/paper_library/arxiv_fetcher.py (448 lines).

Implement ArxivSource against the Source protocol in alcanzai_ingestion/source.py.

Steps:
- can_handle: accept bare arXiv IDs (1706.03762), versioned IDs (1706.03762v2), and arxiv.org URLs.
- resolve: normalize to versioned canonical ID via arXiv API; return CanonicalId(source_plugin='arxiv', value='<id>v<n>').
- fetch: download PDF bytes (validate: >= 1024 bytes, starts with %PDF magic) + Atom XML feed metadata. Write PDF to job artifact dir; store path in FetchResult.source_metadata['artifact_path'].
- normalize: parse Atom metadata → title, authors, year, abstract, doi (if present), arxiv_id. content_type=academic_pdf. blocks=[]. Return RawDocument<Validated>.

Acceptance:
- ArxivSource().can_handle('1706.03762') is True
- resolve('1706.03762') returns CanonicalId(source_plugin='arxiv', value='1706.03762v2')
- normalize(fetch_result) for 1706.03762 returns RawDocument with title='Attention Is All You Need', authors includes 'Vaswani', year=2017, blocks=[]
- uv run pytest -m 'not integration' passes (unit tests mock HTTP; integration tests marked @pytest.mark.integration)
